data.description: With its urban sophistication and sustainable lifestyle, Meydan Dubai is an elegant addition to the city’s dynamic landscape.

data.answer:
Meydan City is in Nad Al Sheba, MBR City. Established in 2007, Dubai Meydan City is home to Meydan Racecourse, the grandstand that hosts one of the world's richest horse races, the Dubai World Cup. 

Situated at the heart of the city, the Meydan Free Zone provides a strategic location and seamless incorporation process, fostering businesses with advanced telecommunications, cutting-edge technology, and flexible business space options.

Meydan City in Nad Al Sheba has many sub-communities with an impressive portfolio of properties, including villas, townhouses, and apartments, set amongst lush green parks. 

Meydan Avenue is a versatile mixed-use area of Meydan anchored by the iconic Grandstand and The Meydan Hotel. It provides residents with apartment buildings, commercial spaces, and plenty of retail options. District Meydan One and Meydan Gated Community also feature sizable clusters of apartments and villas. These zones are designed with a focus on environmental sustainability and have efficient waste management systems.

Millennium Estates, featuring approximately 198 luxury housing villas, stands out as one of the most prominent residential clusters in the area. It offers a variety of furnished and unfurnished units for sale and rent.

Other rapidly developing sub-communities in Meydan include Racecourse Villas and Meydan Business Park. Also, Horizons, a residential development in Meydan City, houses iconic towers such as Meydan Gateway, Horseshoe Plaza, Bathhouse Residences, and Meydan Tower. While much of the area is in the off-plan stage, furnished and unfurnished villas for sale in Meydan City are concentrated in Millennium Estates and Meydan Gated Community.

Most Popular Communities in Meydan City

Meydan City is renowned for its luxurious and well-planned residential communities that offer an exclusive lifestyle. Some of the most popular communities include Meydan Heights, which features elegant villas with spacious layouts and top-tier amenities, ideal for families. 

Another sought-after area is Meydan Avenue, known for its contemporary apartments and proximity to key attractions like the Meydan Racecourse and The Track, Meydan Golf. The Polo Residences and The Polo Townhouses are also prominent, offering serene environments with lush green landscapes and easy access to the Meydan Hotel and Meydan One Mall. 

These communities are favored for their modern infrastructure, high-end facilities, and strategic location, providing residents with a blend of comfort and convenience.

Off-Plan Projects in Meydan Dubai

Many projects are under development in Meydan City, including the highly-awaited The Woodland Residences by Amis Properties. Situated in the central Meydan District 11, this impressive development features 5-bedroom villas, providing an exclusive living experience. MAG 22 is another under-development townhouse project in the area. The MAG Meydan development will feature  2 and 3-BHK units.

Those interested in investing in the luxury properties of the community can consider Naya in Meydan District One. The three-tower residential complex will be handed over in 2027. It will consist of 1 to 3-BHK apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses.

While the town has multiple off-plan properties, various apartments and villas are ready for moving in. A new ready project, ELIE SAAB VIE, at The Fields has 4-bedroom townhouses. These units are available at a starting price of AED 13.5 million. Prime Views is another ready-to-move Meydan Avenue project offering stunning Burj Khalifa views.

Renting a Property in Meydan City Dubai

Are you opting to lease properties in Meydan City Dubai? Azizi Riviera is one of the most popular complexes of apartment buildings in Meydan. Sobha Heartland Dubai is another popular sub-community with apartments, villas and townhouses available for rent. You can explore Magcity Meydan for more rental options.

The annual rent for a one-bedroom flat is AED 85k minimum. For a two- and three-bedroom flat in Meydan City, you must pay AED 113k and AED 140k, respectively.

Similarly, various options are available in the community for villas, including 3, 4, 5, and 6-bedroom houses, ranging in size from 1,800 sq. ft. to 17,061 sq. ft. The annual cost of renting a spacious 5-bedroom villa in Meydan City is approximately AED 302k. For those seeking comparable amenities at a more affordable price point, a 4-bedroom home in Meydan is a viable option, with rental rates ranging between AED 160k and AED 185k per annum.

Buying a Property in Meydan Dubai

Meydan City offers diverse property options, from cozy apartments to spacious independent villas and townhouses. Apartments for sale in Meydan Dubai include one, two, and three-bedroom units. The selling price for 3-bedroom apartments starts at AED 1.2M, with 2-bedroom flats for sale commencing at AED 965k and 1-bedroom apartments at AED 520k.  Also, note that studio apartments in Meydan City cost anywhere from AED 342k to AED 600k.

Likewise, the starting price for a 3-bedroom townhouse in Meydan City is around AED 1.7M, featuring spacious living rooms and private lawns. You can also explore the option for 2-bedroom townhomes in Meydan, ranging from AED 1.2M to AED 1.6M. Larger properties, such as 4-bedroom townhouses for sale in Meydan, are priced at around AED 3 million. Various 5-bedroom villas and 6-bedroom houses in Meydan are available for sale, ranging from AED 5M to 6M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Meydan Dubai?

data.answer:
Meydan is continually evolving, with new projects and developments enhancing the overall lifestyle in the area. Life in Meydan tends to be synonymous with luxury, exclusivity, and a modern urban experience.

The community is well-connected by the road network, with easy access to major highways. Also, Meydan is close to Downtown Dubai, allowing residents easy access to iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountain. This proximity provides additional entertainment, dining, and shopping options.


Public Transportation in Meydan Dubai

Public buses operate through multiple metro stations in and out of the city, while taxis remain the preferred mode of transportation within the community. Taxis can be booked using the RTA app S'hail or ride-hailing services like Uber or Careem. Although the metro is not the most viable option, the nearest station is approximately 15 minutes away in the Business Bay residential area.

The bus stops in Meydan City include the following:

  • 55, Bus Stop: Meydan Racecourse
  • 67, Bus Stop: Meydan Racecourse

Supermarkets in Meydan Dubai

Residents usually go to the Carrefour Supermarket in Burj View Towers, located nearby, to shop for groceries and other essential stuff. The outlet is just a brief 14-minute drive from the residential areas of Millennium Estates and Meydan Gated Community. Spinneys in Dubai, another well-known supermarket chain, has a branch on Meydan Road in Nad Al Sheba 1.

West Zone Fresh Supermarket is a convenient choice for fresh fruits and vegetables, while LuLu Express in Al Quoz, just 10 minutes away, is the preferred destination for the residents.

Shopping Malls Near Meydan Dubai

Adjacent to Meydan City, the community mall on Bay Avenue in Business Bay offers proximity and convenience. Featuring numerous local retailers, casual dining establishments, and an outdoor market area, Bay Avenue provides a vibrant and accessible shopping experience for residents.

Dubai Mall is situated 14 minutes away from the community. The grand shopping center hosts extensive shops, from high-end luxury brands to international and local retailers. Visitors can find everything from fashion and electronics to home decor and specialty stores.

Schools and Nurseries in Meydan Dubai

Notable choices adhering to international standards nearby include Jumeirah International Nursery on Al Abraj Street and Safa British School. GEMS Jumeirah Primary School is a highly regarded institution that follows the British curriculum up to Year 6.

Other alternatives within a 10-minute radius of Meydan City include Hummingbird Nursery, Hartland International School, and Latifa School for Girls.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in Meydan Dubai

Like other regions in Dubai, Meydan City features mosques conveniently located near residences. While there are community mosques, the Nad Al Sheba Great Mosque and Masjid E Ibad Ur Rehman are particularly favored for larger gatherings.

For those seeking churches, The Gatekeepers in Al Quoz and The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints in Al Safa, just a 12-minute drive away, are accessible options. While there are no temples in Meydan City, the renowned Guru Nanak Darbar, a Sikh temple, is reachable within 25 minutes via Sheikh Zayed Road.

Clinics and Hospitals in Meydan Dubai

There are no hospitals inside the community, but Medicare and Emirates Hospital are the two nearest healthcare facilities to Meydan City.

Meydan City Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Meydan City's central location provides residents with convenient access to both the modern urban amenities of Downtown Dubai and the cultural and recreational offerings of surrounding areas. The neighborhood is surrounded by various residential areas, such as Bur Dubai, Al Barari, Al Quoz, Dubailand, and Old Town.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Meydan Dubai

data.answer:
Meydan, Dubai, offers a range of activities and attractions for residents and visitors, from restaurants and bars to hotels and landmarks. You can attend a equestrian Meydan racing Dubai event at the world-famous Meydan Racecourse, enjoy a round of golf at the Meydan Golf Course, or try out international dishes or local specialties at the top fine dining places in the area.

Meydan Dubai Restaurants & Bars

Noteworthy dining establishments near Meydan City include Al Ain Way Restaurant and Cafeteria, The Track Restaurant, Shiba Restaurant, Chez Charles Restaurant, and Farriers. Recognized as one of the finest sports bars in Dubai, Qube Sports Bar, situated on the upper level of Meydan Golf Club Dubai, is a favored spot for screening popular sports shows and TV series. Farriers International Restaurant and Millennium Lounge are some of the top dining options in The Meydan Hotel.

Additionally, Meydan City boasts Iris at the Meydan Grandstand, a premier venue for enjoying live music in Dubai. Meydan City provides excellent options for those inclined toward Dubai's nightlife scene. You can unwind at one of the finest rooftop shisha lounges in Dubai. The Mood Rooftop Lounge The Meydan hotel Dubai United Arab Emirates, offers a vibrant nightlife experience.

Beaches Near Meydan Dubai

While no beaches are nearby, several renowned options are just a short drive away. For example, the widely acclaimed Jumeirah Beach, a popular tourist attraction, is accessible within 19 minutes. Residents often spend quality family evenings at Kite Beach and The Public Beach of Umm Suqeim, both of which are highly favored options.

Hotels in Meydan Dubai

The Meydan Dubai Hotel provides a 5-star staycation experience conveniently situated near the racetrack. It is a popular choice among those participating in or attending major events. The hotel offers fine dining, spa treatments, an outdoor pool, and fitness facilities. The Meydan Bridge Dubai is an architectural wonder, linking the Meydan Hotel to the main road and functioning as an exclusive VIP entrance to the Meydan Racecourse.

Attractions and Landmarks

Meydan Grandstand Dubai United Arab Emirates, is the primary attraction in Meydan City, hosting a series of prestigious horse-riding tournaments. It was opened to the public in 2020, replacing the Nad Al Sheba Racecourse.

The entertainment offerings extend beyond the race tracks and Grandstand, featuring a golf course. The Track Meydan Golf Dubai, situated adjacent to The Meydan Racecourse, welcomes all visitors with its pay-and-play policy.

While Meydan City is perhaps best recognized for the Meydan Racecourse, which hosts the Dubai World Cup, the world's richest horse race, there are other attractions and landmarks in the area as well. The Meydan Golf Course on Al Meydan Road Dubai is an 18-hole championship golf course that offers a unique playing experience. It is designed to international standards and provides picturesque views of the Dubai skyline.

When it comes to nearby attractions, City Walk is the top choice for residents of Meydan City.  A popular urban lifestyle destination, City Walk is 15 minutes away from the community. It combines retail, dining, and entertainment. It's known for its upscale shops, restaurants, and outdoor spaces.

Also a short drive from Meydan City, the Dubai Frame is an architectural landmark that offers panoramic views of old and new Dubai. It provides an immersive experience showcasing the city's transformation.

It features upscale residences that cultivate a lavish living experience for its inhabitants. As a Dubai freehold zone, it is progressively transforming into a well-rounded residential hub. Nevertheless, one should consider factors such as the absence of public transportation within the district and the high cost of properties.

Is Dubai Meydan City completed?

Yes. The community is complete; however, various residential properties are under construction inside the district. 

Is Meydan Dubai a good investment?

Meydan is one of Dubai's prestigious developments, guided by its optimistic vision to provide unparalleled entertainment and exclusive residential properties to the residents of Dubai. This development not only enhances the quality of life but also presents a promising opportunity for a substantial return on investment.

Is Meydan good place to live?

Meydan City is an excellent area to live. The community is associated with luxury living, featuring high-end residential properties, modern architecture, and upscale amenities. If you appreciate a luxurious lifestyle, Meydan is the place to be.

What are the amenities in Meydan?

Meydan offers residents amenities such as gyms, restaurants, and the iconic Meydan Racecourse, a large 9-hole golf course.

What area is Meydan in?

Meydan City is located in MBR City along Ras Al Khor Road.

Who owns Meydan Dubai?

Developed under His Highness Sheikh Rashid Bin Maktoum’s vision, Meydan Dubai is a project of the Meydan Group.

Why is Meydan freezone the best place for investment?

Meydan is in proximity to key landmarks, providing investors with numerous strategic advantages. It houses spacious office spaces and fully serviced offices, suitable for a diverse range of businesses, including commercial, consulting, investment, and administrative companies.

The free zone also boasts a 5-star hotel, a premium golf course, and serves as the venue for the Dubai World Cup, recognized as the world's wealthiest horse race.

What is the distance between Meydan and Mainland Dubai?

For those traveling from Dubai Marina, the distance to Meydan Racecourse is approximately 25.5 km.

Where can I find accommodation in Meydan?

A suitable lodging option is the Meydan Hotel, close to the racecourse and grandstand.

What types of rooms are available at The Meydan Hotel?

Hotel Meydan offers various room options, including double, twin, or suite accommodations, with varying charges.

How can I travel from the airport to The Meydan Hotel?

The Meydan Hotel is a 25-minute drive from the nearest airport, and transportation options include taxis or online cab services.

How can I reach Meydan Racecourse?

To reach Meydan Racecourse, you can opt for the metro to Burjuman Metro Station and then take a bus from Burjuman Metro Bus Stop A to Nad Al Sheba, Clinic 61D.

How far is Burj Khalifa from Meydan City?

The iconic Burj Khalifa landmark is located at a distance of 12 km.
Downtown Dubai, a bustling business hub and popular tourist destination, is approximately 10 km away.

How far is Dubai International Airport from Meydan City?

With slight traffic on the road, it takes around 20 minutes to reach Dubai International Airport.

What are the leisure activities available in Meydan City?

Meydan City offers a wide range of leisure activities catering to various interests and preferences. The Meydan Racecourse is a premier destination for horse racing enthusiasts, hosting the prestigious Dubai World Cup. For golf lovers, The Track, Meydan Golf provides a challenging 9-hole course with stunning views of the city skyline. 

Residents can also enjoy a day at the Meydan One Mall, which features a vast array of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities, including an indoor ski slope and a state-of-the-art cinema.

data.content:
Once recognized primarily as a horse racing venue, Meydan Dubai has become an integrated, family-friendly community. Easily accessible via Ras Al Khor Road and Al Ain Road, the district is a hub of business opportunities, leisure, and luxurious amenities. Its name, Meydan, is derived from the Arabic term that means a meeting place.

Designed as per the vision of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, UAE Vice President, Prime Minister, and Ruler of Dubai, the neighborhood is part of Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City. It boasts a sustainable, forward-thinking lifestyle and hosts many sporting and leisure events.

Meydan City is known for its strategic location and expansive 40 million sq. ft. area. The geographical advantage and access to a luxurious lifestyle make Meydan City a noteworthy destination for investors and residents.

nodes.title: Tura Residence
nodes.about:
Tura Residence in Meydan introduces a boutique residential project designed for modern urban living in one of Dubai’s most strategically located districts. The development features five floors with just 22 thoughtfully planned residences, including 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments designed for comfort, functionality, and long-term investment potential with strong capital appreciation.

Tura Residence by Namat Real Estate Development combines refined architecture with practical living spaces, delivering premium interiors, open layouts, and natural light throughout each home. Residents will benefit from amenities such as an infinity pool, gym, yoga studio, and a dedicated kids’ playing area, enhancing the overall quality and value of the development. The apartments can be booked with a 10% down payment.

nodes.title: Winslow
nodes.about:
Winslow by IGO is a contemporary mixed-use residential development located in the prime Meydan Horizon community. The project features a mix of residential, office, and retail units. The tower offers spacious 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, with layouts reaching up to 2,992 sq. ft., designed to provide clear views, open horizons, and composed modern interiors.

The building includes 62 offices across podium levels 1 to 4 and 8 retail spaces on the ground floor, creating an active yet balanced environment for residents. A curated selection of amenities, including a fully equipped gym, infinity pool, and landscaped terrace garden supports both active routines and relaxed living. The project is scheduled for handover in Q2 2028 and offers a structured 60/40 payment plan, providing investors with flexibility and long-term planning advantages.

nodes.title: Sanctuary
nodes.about:
Sanctuary by Prestige One is a refined mixed-use development rising in Meydan Horizon, designed across 24 floors with a limited collection of 161 units. The project features thoughtfully planned 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments alongside dedicated office spaces, offering a balanced lifestyle within a well-connected urban setting, supporting strong capital appreciation potential.

Sanctuary Meydan Horizon places strong emphasis on curated living experiences. Residents benefit from wellness-driven amenities including a waterfall feature & sunken island pool, kids’ play area, outdoor fitness zones, and an outdoor cinema, all designed to complement contemporary lifestyles while supporting sustained value growth without compromising privacy or tranquility.

nodes.title: The Caden
nodes.about:
The Caden by Prescott Dubai rises as a refined residential landmark within Meydan Horizon, bringing together contemporary architecture and future-focused living. Spanning 23 floors with 221 residences, the development presents a curated collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, complemented by expansive 4-bedroom duplexes and a signature 5-bedroom penthouse.

The Caden in Meydan Horizon blends intelligent design with lifestyle-driven amenities. Infinity pools, an AI-powered fitness center, a private theatre, clubhouse, and sky deck shape a wellness-oriented experience, while its setting and design philosophy support long-term capital appreciation potential.

nodes.title: Mercedes-Benz Places Binghatti City
nodes.about:
Mercedes-Benz Places – Binghatti City at Meydan is the world’s first Mercedes-Benz branded city, redefining branded living through an ambitious urban vision. With a total investment value of Dh30 billion, this landmark destination is developed by Binghatti as its first fully master-planned community, setting a new benchmark for integrated luxury development in Dubai.

Designed as a multi-tower branded city, the project features Mercedes-Benz-branded residential towers located in Nad Al Sheba, offering studio and 3-bedroom apartments with high ROI potential. Planned elements include cultural and leisure districts, retail boulevards, parks and green corridors, mobility hubs, and wellness and sports zones.

nodes.title: Maybach
nodes.about:
Maybach Mercedes-Benz Places - Binghatti City is a refined residential destination located in Meydan, developed by Binghatti. Comprising 831 thoughtfully designed units, the 31-storey tower presents studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments shaped by precision architecture and contemporary urban planning.

Maybach at Binghatti City integrates retail boulevards, parks, mobility hubs, and wellness and sports zones. Beyond lifestyle appeal, the project is designed to support long-term capital appreciation, driven by location strength, branded identity, and cohesive community planning.
